title: Hatsune Miku — Where Feelings Come Together〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I should be able to get there earlier than I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If there's room available, I might be able to get some practice in before we start.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So this is the trailer for this year's VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Where VIRTUAL SINGER fans and artists, both amateur and professional, all gather.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... It'd be nice to participate in some way since we finally decided to form a band...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we just did our very first show. Amateur artists may be welcome to join, but it may be too soon for us to perform in this kind of event.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for coming along to shop with me today, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome! But you have practice this afternoon too, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, it's Miku! Is that a new trailer?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can't really tell from here...
Maybe they're promoting an event?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, Miku's so cute when she's singing on stage like this. The way she shines and sparkles...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like it when Miku sings edgier or more dramatic songs and looks so cool doing it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad and I actually got to speak a little today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But he still can't really recall who I am.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. That CD is being released soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I'm forgetting its name...
I remember that it's a VIRTUAL SINGER album...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (At the same time, I never thought that I'd become this interested in Miku songs...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll go meet her later...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What's this?
I'm sensing some warm and gentle feelings gathering.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, where could Miku have gone?
She promised to stand in as the character opposite mine for rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To think that I'm practicing and rehearsing with Miku now after such a chaotic first meeting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But everyone in SEKAI's been such a great help that I'm coming here on a regular basis now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I need to show them my appreciation...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? There's something at my feet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's this?
A ball of light...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just arrived at the studio and was about to let everyone know where I was, but ended up here after my phone began acting up...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, did you hear that just now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't think we're alone here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Other people are here...?
Maybe I should try finding them instead of just wandering around.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Those voices came from...
I think that tree over there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tsukasa? You're here too, Minori, Kohane? How?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My phone flashed and before we knew it, we were here...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, the same thing happened to me too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Your phones brought you here?
I'm here because of this strange ball of light I found...
Ah, that must be a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now I understand.
This place exists because your feelings have become deeply intertwined.
